name: Accordion
summary: Sections that expand and collapse in place: Thread setup, FAQs, groups of settings.

name: AppShell
summary: The frame of every signed-in screen. It places the top bar, the module bar, the sidebar, the page content, the inspector and the floating prompt bar, and handles their scrolling and stacking.

name: Avatar
summary: A person's photo, or their initials when there is no photo. Square avatars stand for companies and workspaces.

name: AvatarGroup
summary: Overlapping avatars for a team, contributors or who's in a call, with "+N" for the rest.

name: Badge
summary: A short label for a state or a type, in a tone color.

name: Banner
summary: A message about a page or section that stays until it is resolved or dismissed.

name: Breadcrumbs
summary: Shows where a page sits and links back up: Workspace › Marketing & growth › Campaign Studio.

name: Button
summary: Triggers an action. Five variants, each with one job, so a person can tell at a glance which button matters.

name: Card
summary: The one container for grouped content. Module cards, profile cards, funnel steps and panels all start from it.

name: Checkbox
summary: A yes/no choice inside a form, or one of several independent choices in a list.

name: Combobox
summary: Pick one value from a long list by typing to filter it: the company switcher, assigning a person, choosing a service from dozens.

name: ComingSoon
summary: The teaser page before launch: logo, the eyebrow "Extraordinary talent. Everyday solutions.", the headline "Coming soon.", the line "Los Angeles Call Sheet" and one button, "Get on the call sheet". It sits on a curved panel over the quiet Europium backdrop, lit by a mint horizon glow; the button and field glow on hover and focus.

name: CommandPalette
summary: ⌘K: jump to any module, company or action by typing.

name: ConfirmDialog
summary: Asks before something destructive or hard to undo.

name: Count
summary: A number pill after a label: category totals, tab counts, unread items.

name: Drawer
summary: A panel that slides in from the left or right edge and blocks the page until it's closed. The sidebar and inspector become drawers on smaller screens; settings and setup panels use it on every screen.

name: EmptyState
summary: Fills a view with nothing to show yet, and says how to start.

name: Field
summary: Wraps one form control with its label and its help or error text, and connects them for screen readers.

name: FilterBar
summary: The recessed row of search and filters above a collection (Workspace hub, material library, People & profiles).

name: FlowConnector
summary: The arrow between two steps on a flow or funnel canvas, with an optional label for what the person does to move on.

name: FunnelStepCard
summary: One step on the Funnel Studio canvas: what kind of step it is, its order, status, a preview and what happens there.

name: GigsterOnboarding
summary: Five steps from "about you" to a profile ready for review, with a live preview of how clients will see you beside the form.

name: GigsterProfile
summary: A Gigster's public profile: portrait hero over an ambient glow from their own work, a sticky booking card, section tabs that follow the scroll, services, a bento portfolio with a lightbox, example reviews, experience, FAQs and similar professionals.

name: IconButton
summary: A square button that shows only an icon, for toolbars and dense headers where the icon is universally understood.

name: Input
summary: A single-line text field. The focus ring sits on the whole frame, so icons and units stay inside it.

name: Kbd
summary: A keyboard key or shortcut, shown next to the action it triggers or inside menus and the command palette.

name: Logo
summary: The Between Gigs logo, drawn from the approved files. Its inks follow the theme of the surface it sits on: the on-light file's colors in light theme, the on-dark file's in dark theme and inside dark-theme islands.

name: Menu
summary: A list of actions or choices opened from a button: Appearance, account, row actions, the company switcher.

name: Modal
summary: A focused task that blocks the page until it's done or dismissed. With `placement="right"` it becomes a drawer.

name: ModuleCard
summary: A module in the Workspace hub: status, version, live preview, the open action and build progress.

name: NavItem
summary: One row in the sidebar or a section nav, with an icon and an optional count. `NavSection` groups rows under a title.

name: PageHeader
summary: The top of every app page: where you are, what this is, and what you can do here.

name: PageTransition
summary: Animated moves between pages and views, on the browser's View Transitions API: the old page animates out while the new one animates in. Eight effects: `shift` (the quiet default), `slide`, `push`, `zoom`, `reveal`, `wipe`, `flip` and `dissolve`.

name: Pager
summary: Steps through a set one item or page at a time: Coverflow, stacked profile cards, long result lists.

name: Parallax
summary: Moves decorative art at a different speed from the scroll, for depth: hero marks, covers, background shapes.

name: Popover
summary: A small panel of settings or details anchored to a button, that doesn't block the page: Appearance, Material box, Mouse & gestures, a "With you" call panel.

name: ProfileCard
summary: A professional in search results: who they are, what they do, where, when, and from how much.

name: Progress
summary: Shows how far something has come: a module's build, founding cards claimed, an upload.

name: RadioGroup
summary: One choice from two to five options that should all be visible at once.

name: Reveal
summary: Animates content in as it scrolls into view. Eight effects: `fade-up`, `scale-in`, `blur-in`, `slide-left`, `slide-right`, `clip-up`, `tilt-in` and `pop`.

name: ScrollProgress
summary: A thin mint bar that fills as you scroll: reading progress on long pages, guides and the Journal.

name: SearchResults
summary: Find a Gigster: a brand hero with the people in it, a search bar lifted over its edge, service pills, filters, sort, list or grid, and a rail with an illustrative neighbourhood map and how it works.

name: SegmentedControl
summary: Switches between views of the same content, such as Gallery / List / Coverflow / Tiles or Default / Light / Dark.

name: Select
summary: Picks one value from a short list. The list is drawn by the design system, not the operating system, so it has the same rounded, raised look as Menu and Combobox in both themes.

name: Skeleton
summary: A placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading. Use for loads over about 300ms.

name: Slider
summary: Picks a value on a continuous range where the exact number matters less than the feel: card size, shine, pointer size, canvas transparency.

name: StageStats
summary: Counts per stage of a pipeline, in order: Invited → Signed in → Draft → Submitted → Changes requested → Approved → In gallery.

name: Stat
summary: One headline number with its label. `StatRow` lays several out between hairlines.

name: StatusBadge
summary: The product's fixed status vocabulary. Each word always appears in the same color, everywhere.

name: Stepper
summary: Shows where someone is in a multi-step flow, such as the four-step profile builder.

name: Switch
summary: Turns a setting on or off immediately, with no save step.

name: Table
summary: Rows of records that share the same fields: people, invitations, campaigns, the review queue.

name: Tabs
summary: Switches between sections of one page. This is the only tab style in the product: underline tabs, with optional counts.

name: Tag
summary: Keywords on cards ("Alterations", "Closet styling"), filter chips ("Silver Lake") and removable selections.

name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text: project descriptions, review notes, prompts, hypotheses.

name: ThemeToggle
summary: The Day/Night switch: a sliding sun and moon. Left uncontrolled, it switches the whole page with a circular reveal that grows from the switch.

name: Toast
summary: A brief confirmation that something just happened, with an optional Undo.

name: Tooltip
summary: A short label shown on hover and focus, mostly to name icon-only controls or show a shortcut.

name: WorkspaceTile
summary: A company workspace in the Playset gallery: cover, relationship, name, state and the open link.
